entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes... I have an order and I think I need to send something back. I'm just so confused by the website. My order number is... uh... VF88201.
Okay, VF88201. Let me pull that up. I see an order for one 'Apex Trail Helmet' delivered three days ago. Is that the item you're calling about?
Yes, the helmet. I don't think it's right.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, I don't know. A preference? The color on the website looked much brighter. This one is... sort of dull. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I just don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help you with that. It sounds like the color wasn't what you expected, and that's no problem at all. Since you received the helmet just a few days ago, you're well within our 90-day return window for apparel and gear.
Oh, really? That's a relief. I was so worried. The website was talking about 10 days and 20 days... it was a lot.

I understand it can be a bit confusing. That stricter policy is for our new electronic devices, but for your helmet, it's the standard 90 days. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear. Getting the right color is important, and feeling good in your equipment is a big part of safety and confidence on the trail.
It is! Thank you for understanding. So... what do I do now?

I can start the return process for you right now. I'll just confirm you want to return the helmet due to the color preference. And since you mentioned the box is unopened, that makes it very straightforward. I am processing that now... Okay. I've just sent an email to the address on file with a pre-paid return label and instructions. Do you see that come through?
Oh! Yes, I see it right here. Wow, that was easy. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, you'll get a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
